title: Binding of Isaac pulls AI music after backlash 🎵
subject: bindingofisaac
description:
Should Steam enforce AI disclosures harder? 👇

Players found Suno metadata in the music of a GTA 6-themed daily run added to The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+. Recent Steam reviews dropped to Overwhelmingly Negative. Edmund McMillen said he didn't know, and Nicalis pushed a PC patch removing the generated music files on November 21; console patches were submitted for approval.

Sources: Edmund McMillen and Nicalis on X (Nov 21, 2026), Dexerto (Nov 21, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 23, 2026), Superpower Daily (Nov 21, 2026)
Game footage © Nicalis / Edmund McMillen.

scenes.text: The Binding of Isaac just pulled AI-made music.
A Repentance+ update added a GTA 6-themed daily run, seed V1CE BSMT.
Players on Reddit found "made with Suno" tags in its 7 song files. Steam showed no AI disclosure.
Recent Steam reviews sank to Overwhelmingly Negative, just 10% positive out of 908.
On November 21, creator Edmund McMillen said he had no idea the run used generated music.
Hours later, Nicalis pushed a PC patch removing the files. Console fixes await approval.
